status: candidate policy; archive and recall service options are design only

evaluation.primary: human preference for what to retain and when to use it

importance.appraiser: same local dialogue model on a separate state
importance.explicit_floor: supported by deterministic ranking API but not enabled in fixed-weight replay
importance.on_invalid: pending; never turn missing evidence into zero

emotion_intensity.appraiser: same model on a clean state fork
emotion_intensity.basis: intensity of the user's own expression; no type or valence

repetition.appraiser: same model on a clean state fork
repetition.evidence: distinct original user turns for the same item version, with quotes and timestamps

recency.appraiser: same model on a clean state fork
recency.evidence: last independent user mention and assessment time in UTC

seed.selection: descending unrounded score then item id; keep fitting prefix

recall.default: off unless historical evidence is needed
